description: Statistics computed server-side on verified autario indicators (World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, OECD, IMF, WHO, SEC): correlation, regression, growth, drivers, seasonality, value checks.

a.description: correlate: First indicator ID calculate: First operand A (the numerator of a ratio). Indicator id of a numeric series, exactly as find_data action "indicators" or get_data action "profile" return it (a public indicator or one of your own uploads or connector tables). lag_analysis: First indicator id (candidate leading series)

action.description: Which operation to run. describe = summary statistics and trend of one series, needs indicator, entity; correlate = correlation between two series, needs entity, a, b; regression = linear regression of y on x, needs entity, y, x; pct_change = percent change and growth over a period, needs entity, indicator; rolling_stats = rolling mean, sum or other window statistic, needs entity, indicator; calculate = arithmetic between two series, checked for compatible meaning, needs a, b, entity; lag_analysis = lead and lag between two series, needs a, b, entity; seasonality = trend, seasonal and residual parts of a series, needs indicator, entity; find_drivers = which candidate indicators move with a target, needs entity, target_indicator, candidates; decompose_drivers = share of a target's change explained by each candidate, needs target_indicator, candidates; what_matters = ranked factors behind an outcome, needs entity, outcome; verify_value = check a quoted number against the source, needs indicator, entity, time.

b.description: correlate: Second indicator ID calculate: Second operand B (the denominator of a ratio). Indicator id of a numeric series, exactly as find_data action "indicators" or get_data action "profile" return it (a public indicator or one of your own uploads or connector tables). lag_analysis: Second indicator id (candidate lagging series)

candidates.description: find_drivers: Candidate indicator IDs to test (max 30) decompose_drivers: Candidate indicator ids to decompose jointly (2-15) what_matters: Optional comma-separated candidate indicator ids. If omitted, auto-selects from ontology.

entity.description: describe, regression, pct_change, rolling_stats, calculate, seasonality: Entity the series is read for: an ISO 3166 alpha-3 country code such as "DEU" or "USA", or an aggregate code such as "WLD" or "EUU" (the canonical name matches too). Use the codes find_data action "indicators" and get_data action "profile" accept. correlate, find_drivers: Entity code (e.g. DEU) lag_analysis: Entity code (e.g. USA) decompose_drivers: Entity code (e.g. DEU). Omit for entity-less private series. what_matters: Entity code (e.g. USA, DEU) verify_value: Entity code (e.g. DEU, USA, EUU)

expected.description: The value you want to verify. Omit for existence-only check.

format.description: Output wire format for this MCP call. Default 'toon' (Token-Oriented Notation, fewest tokens, best for tabular rows). 'compact' = minified JSON. 'json' = pretty JSON for readability. The REST API always returns JSON regardless.

full.description: Return the full raw time series (heavy, many tokens). Default false → you get only the summary/stats, which is enough to ANSWER a question. Set true only when you must plot or export every point.

indicator.description: describe, pct_change, rolling_stats, seasonality: Indicator id of a numeric series, exactly as find_data action "indicators" or get_data action "profile" return it (a public indicator or one of your own uploads or connector tables). verify_value: Indicator ID

max_lag.description: lag_analysis: Max lag in periods (1-20, default 5) decompose_drivers: Max lead/lag periods to scan per candidate (0 disables, default 5, max 20)

op.description: rolling_stats: mean | std | min | max | sum (default: mean) calculate: ratio | ratio_pct | diff | sum | product (default: ratio)

outcome.description: Indicator id of the outcome metric

override.description: Compute a combination autario refused as incompatible. Requires `reason`.

period.description: pct_change: yoy | qoq | mom (default: yoy) seasonality: Seasonal period in time steps (12=monthly, 4=quarterly, 7=weekly). Auto-inferred from indicator frequency if omitted.

reason.description: Why the refused combination is correct here. Returned with the result so a human can audit the decision.

target_indicator.description: The KPI you want to explain

time.description: describe, regression, pct_change, rolling_stats, calculate, lag_analysis, seasonality, find_drivers, decompose_drivers, what_matters: Optional time window. "2010-2023" keeps 2010 through 2023, "2019-01-2024-06" works by month, and a single "2015" keeps 2015 onward. Omitted or unparseable = the whole series. correlate: Optional time range: "2010-2023" verify_value: Time period (e.g. "2023" or "2023-06")

name: analyze
